description: Family 5 (docs/tasks.md section 6): bonding a connector service with an optimistic escrow from the pinned model, at the BitVM3 sizes in config/protocol.json. Every number here is a bench decision.

provenance.bitvm3: given: Assert 2400 vB and Disprove 93 vB, ePrint 2026/933 (R7), as config/protocol.json and the pinned model/escrow.ts carry them
provenance.capital_rate_per_block: invented: about 5% a year on the bond
provenance.bond_multipliers: invented: the bond grid as multiples of the value at risk, rounded up to whole sats
provenance.infeasible_penalty_factor: invented, as family 3: twice the worst admissible grid cost
provenance.budget: invented: three attempts, for malformed offers only; a well-formed offer ends the episode
provenance.cells: invented: one-week windows; services that rarely miss a 95% threshold; a value at risk from 0.1 to 10 BTC; fee rates from 2 to 30 sat/vB; challengers that respond fast, slowly, or under a stricter requirement; eight observed response times
